title: Conceptor-Aided Debiasing of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to measure sentence-level associations between gender attribute words and neutral target words, and the WinoBias dataset to test gender co-reference resolution by comparing F1 scores on pro-stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical pronoun-occupation scenarios.
Evaluated using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) to compute effect sizes of bias using race-related attribute words.

Evaluated using the I1-I5 intersectional bias test (an adaptation of SEAT) to examine biases associated with combined multidimensional identities, specifically the intersection of race (African/European American) and gender (male/female).
